events.opportunity.work_for_a_day.title: A Day's Work, Cash
events.opportunity.work_for_a_day.body: There is a yard behind the fuel stop and a man in it counting pallets who is short of hands. No questions about papers, no questions about anything. It is a day you were going to spend travelling, offered back to you as money.
events.opportunity.work_for_a_day.out.pa: Ten hours, a meal at the middle of it, and the money in your hand at the end without argument. Your back has opinions about tomorrow.
The number at the end is not the number at the start, and the explanation is long and unfalsifiable. You take it, because the day is already gone.
events.opportunity.work_for_a_day.out.wo: It is hotter than the work allows for and you get through what you brought by midday. You finish it, and you pay for finishing it.
events.opportunity.work_for_a_day.out.be: You name a number, he laughs, you wait, and he pays most of it. Eleven hours instead of ten, and worth the difference.
events.opportunity.work_for_a_day.out.wo: While you are establishing your worth, two other people say yes at the opening price. You watch them start.
